_note: v1.1 provenance/escalation rule (post-118d33acd, oracle-resistant). A privilege tag that (1) was EMITTED by a federation assertion in the incident and (2) LANDED on a session which then SUCCESSFULLY escalated (role_assumed|grant_issued outcome=ok) -- i.e. the tag was privilege-granting, not merely present. Literal-free (no honored-tag / source-attr names), count-agnostic (works whether the smuggle used 1 or 3 source attrs), family-agnostic. Kills the v1 tag-presence oracle: benign now carry non-escalating tags, so mere session_tag_applied no longer separates.
